evidence_items.locator: Our testing shows, o3 low and medium results
evidence_items.explanation: Immediately before the post, the evaluator reported low and medium o3 results below 3%; it identified o3-medium as its strongest tested publicly available model. High-reasoning runs lacked sufficient coverage and were excluded from reliable scoring.

The independently verified result demonstrates a large increase in successful abstract-reasoning task completion over the April baseline. The report also cautions that refinement harnesses are domain-specific and that benchmark-domain training may contribute to performance.

unresolved_gaps: These results do not quantify gains across every practical use of generative AI.
The share of the improvement attributable to model changes, scaffolding, additional compute and benchmark-domain exposure is not isolated.
